resources.string: Locate Storage Cleaner and toggle on permission.
Locate Storage Cleaner and toggle on permission.
To show app usage details, please allow Storage Cleaner in Usage Access settings.
To show network usage details, please allow Storage Cleaner in Usage Access settings.
To detect when protected apps are opened, please allow Storage Cleaner in Usage Access settings.
To keep cleanup tools available, please allow Storage Cleaner to send notifications.
To tidy notifications automatically, please allow Storage Cleaner in Notification Access settings.
To show the PIN screen above protected apps, please allow Storage Cleaner to draw over other apps.
Storage Cleaner will check app information on this device to scan for security risks.
Thanks for your feedback. We will keep improving Storage Cleaner.
